title: Pyramids as generators of plasma energy

tellings.quote: I do think I do think that it had something to do with the uh generation of some kind of energy. And if I had to pick an energy I would say plasma energy.

plain: A researcher named Randall Carlson, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says he thinks the pyramids at Giza in Egypt were built to generate some kind of energy. If he had to pick one, he says, it would be plasma, an electrically charged gas, and he draws on the work of a man named Bob Greener. If true, it would mean the pyramids were machines and not only tombs.
